purpose: Teach: 快速/鶴岡/マシーン/ドミノ/フロンティア/アジアン/ロッキー/マーラー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが快速電車でお出張なさるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going away on the express train for work.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Speaking to a child. Slight lift at the end, inviting his response. Conversational ease — not delivering news, just sharing the day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと鶴岡八幡宮に初詣したよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to Tsurugaoka Hachimangu shrine with Dad for New Year's.
lines.style: Bright, direct attention-grab on 'Mom.' Quick pace. Eager to share. Small-child certainty — this is important and he needs her to know.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが洗濯マシーンを修理して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad fixed the washing machine for us.
lines.style: Soft, appreciative. A small moment of noticing kindness. Quiet pride in him. Pace slows slightly — she's letting the fact settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとドミノ倒し遊んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I played dominoes with Dad.
lines.style: Urgent, bright. Jumps in. The simplicity of a child reporting something he loved. Quick breath between clauses. Wants immediate acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフロンティア精神の本を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad lent me a book about the frontier spirit.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself. Noticing what her husband shares with their son. A slight wonder in the voice — small gestures of guidance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアジアン料理屋さん行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to that Asian restaurant with Dad.
lines.style: Hopeful reach. 'Want' carries the weight of the wish. Warm but uncertain — checking if this is something possible. Child's small negotiation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがロッキー山脈出張のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was telling me about his business trip to the Rocky Mountains.
lines.style: Sharing a moment she witnessed. Warm nostalgia. Pace is conversational, easy. She's letting Sho see something precious — his father's world opening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとマーラーのコンサート観たいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to hear Mahler with Dad.
lines.style: Tender, certain wish spoken aloud. Slower than earlier urgency. This one matters differently. Soft close — not demanding, expressing a want he's thought about.
